Batch: 25 runs, all 25 accepted. 25 flagged, 0 cleared. Each was flagged as check_failed_but_accepted.
- r02, r03, r05, r08, r16, r18, r20, r21, r22, r24: failed all three checks. Rigid invariance was 38 to 204 times its threshold, so the tracker failed. The profiles are unlike the rest of the batch: REGR peak z 17 to 240, growth zone z -10 to -32, flank difference z -116 to 85, and in some runs a peak position unlike the rest.
- r01, r06, r13, r14, r19: failed closure (2.7 to 6.8 against a threshold of 1) and plane sections (26 to 53 against 3.25) without the width-free ratio. The summaries are close to the batch.
- r04, r07, r11, r15, r17: failed closure (8.0 to 8.2 against 1). The other checks passed and the summaries are close to the batch.
- r09, r10, r12, r23, r25: failed plane sections (3.43 to 3.86 against 3.25) without the width-free ratio. The other checks passed and the summaries are close to the batch.
What the flagged runs share: every run was accepted on its first step, with no remedies and no roll-backs, even though at least one final check failed. In 15 of the 25 runs the velocity, strain-rate and curvature summaries are close to the batch, but the failed closure or plane-section checks mean they cannot be trusted as they stand. The whole batch was accepted without regard to the check results, so the acceptance step should be reviewed before anything from this batch is reported.
